claims.summary: Over any field F, for a finite set X in F^n, B_D the polynomials of degree <=D vanishing on X, U=V_K/(B_D cap V_K) and errors E_1..E_s of degree <=e with K+e<=D: the map u->[E_j u] in V_D/B_D has rank dim U|_{S_j}, S_j the support of E_j on X, and the stacked map has rank dim U|_S, S the union of the supports; the restriction U|_S -> direct sum of U|_{S_j} is injective, so the sum of ranks exceeds the stacked rank by its cokernel dimension. With X the Boolean cube over F_p this is the domain-only model of cor:pang-observation-calibration at Pang's cutoff Delta+K+d<=D, where every saving over the sum is a union-of-supports interpolation count; such savings carry into Pang's proper quotient since B_D is inside C_D.
claims.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer with corrections (cokernel instead of overlap, general field and point set, Pang-form witness, carry-over to the proper quotient); a rediscovery-level fact about function quotients.
claims.rationale: Fixes what a joint saving in Pang's contraction must use beyond the domain relations: degree truncation or nilpotence of the proper quotient.
claims.next_action: Compare stacked rank with the domain-only count in a degree-truncated quotient of a small unsatisfiable system.
